extensions.scope: Public showcase page (showcase/index.html) only. The Electron app UI in src/ has its own zinc UI and is out of scope.

numeral.purpose: The monumental catalog count that is the hero headline. font-stretch 96%. clamp(7.5rem, 44vw, 11rem) at 640px and below.

display.purpose: The closing call, full width. font-stretch 96%.

headline.purpose: Stage and section names, a word or short phrase with a full stop.

title.purpose: The hero sentence beneath the numeral.

statement.purpose: The paragraph opposite each headline, bottom-aligned, max 36ch.

body.purpose: Running text and table cells; tabular figures page-wide.

label.purpose: Table and list heads, Fig. n labels, the Copy button. Not uppercase, not tracked out.

action.purpose: The primary line of the download block.

mono.purpose: System mono for real commands, file names and recorded output only.

grid.overlay: position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 0; pointer-events: none; mix-blend-mode: difference; 12 columns with 1px #1c1c1c side borders; 4 columns at 640px and below; content sheets sit above at z-index 1

motion.name: gate
motion.purpose: Added by a head script only when reduced motion is not requested and IntersectionObserver exists. Every hidden state is scoped under .motion.

motion.name: reveal-observer
motion.purpose: One-shot entrance trigger for headlines, statements, figures, panels, tables and actions.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Default easing for entrances and state transitions.

motion.name: ease-press
motion.purpose: Wipes, imprints and the download reveal.

motion.name: drop
motion.purpose: Module columns draw down on load.

motion.name: dash
motion.purpose: The mark's chevrons draw themselves.

motion.name: pop
motion.purpose: The mark's four cells pop in.

motion.name: imprint
motion.purpose: The hero numeral is revealed bottom-up.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: Headline letters and hero words rise out of a blur.

motion.name: lift
motion.purpose: General entrance for statements, captions, rows, nav and secondary actions.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: The white download block wipes in from the left.

motion.name: wipe
motion.purpose: A zinc #3f3f46 block sweeps across a figure frame.

motion.name: show
motion.purpose: The screenshot appears behind the wipe.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: The screenshot settles from 1.08 scale.

motion.name: print
motion.purpose: Output panels print top-down.

motion.name: lamp
motion.purpose: Hosting type cells light up in sequence; a 650ms walking lamp follows.

motion.name: markpop
motion.purpose: A stage mark pops when the lifecycle fill reaches it.

motion.name: nudge
motion.purpose: The download arrow nudges down twice.

motion.name: blink
motion.purpose: The typing caret and the current Run step marker; both settle solid.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Kill switch for every animation and transition.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: Nav hides, hero and stages stack, hosting types go to 4 columns, closing actions go full width.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: 4-module overlay, lifecycle rule moves to the margin, tables become stacked labelled rows, hosting types go to 2 columns.

narrative.overview:
The page is an International Typographic Style poster printed white on a black sheet. A visible 12-column module grid stands behind everything, numbers are the headlines, type sits flush left in one grotesk at extreme scale contrast, and the only pictures are objective records: real app screenshots and real CLI output, numbered as figures. Composition comes from ruled full-width rows and grid placement, never from boxes.

Every section is black. White is reserved for type, the mark, rules that carry structure, and the one action block per viewport. Grey exists only in the zinc family, for captions, hairlines and states. There is no hue anywhere on the page, which is a binding brand commitment.

One continuous vertical rule runs down the lifecycle stages (Pick, Generate, Run, Host, Upgrade) and fills as the reader scrolls; each stage's numbered square mark sits on it. Motion is a printing process: things are drawn, wiped, imprinted and printed line by line, and the whole page is complete without it.
keyCharacteristics: Black sheet throughout; white only for type, the mark, structural rules and the single action block.
Visible 12-column module grid, fixed behind the content.
One family (Archivo variable) from 0.8125rem labels to 25rem numerals; system mono only for real code and output.
Ruled rows and ruled tables instead of cards; square corners everywhere.
Figures are real screenshots and real CLI output, captioned "Fig. n".
Motion gated behind `html.motion`; the static page is the complete page.

rules.name: The Black Sheet Rule
rules.body: Every section background is ink. There are no white or grey section bands; the earlier alternating-sheet idea was dropped by the user.

rules.name: The One White Block Rule
rules.body: At most one filled white block per viewport, and it is the primary action (Download). Secondary actions are outlined, never filled.

rules.name: The No Hue Rule
rules.body: No colour outside black, white and zinc, including in states, diffs and status: emphasis is weight and white, de-emphasis is grey or strike-through.

rules.name: The Number Is The Headline Rule
rules.body: Counts from the real catalog are set as display type, not decorated; never invent a number to fill the slot.

rules.name: The Real Mono Rule
rules.body: Mono appears only for text a user would type or a program printed. Labels, captions and navigation are never mono.

rules.name: The Rule Not Box Rule
rules.body: Structure is drawn with lines on the sheet. A region earns a border only when it frames a real artifact (a screenshot or an output panel).

dos: **Do** keep every section on the ink sheet and reserve white for type, the mark, structural rules and one action block per viewport.
**Do** place everything on the 12-column grid using the margin and gutter clamps, and keep the module overlay visible.
**Do** build sections from ruled rows: 2px white rule under heads, 1px Zinc Hairline between rows.
**Do** show only real screenshots and real CLI output, framed in 1px hairlines and captioned "Fig. n" with continuous numbering.
**Do** set catalog counts and stage names as display type with tight tracking (-0.045em to -0.06em) and short line heights (0.76–0.86).
**Do** gate every hidden state behind `.motion` so the static page is complete, and keep the reduced-motion kill switch.
**Do** use mono only for commands, file names and recorded output.
donts: **Don't** add white or grey section bands; every section is black.
**Don't** use cards: no boxed tiles, feature grids, rounded containers or drop shadows.
**Don't** introduce any hue, including for success, error, diff or status states.
**Don't** put eyebrows or kickers (small uppercase labels) above headlines; the headline stands alone.
**Don't** add a second filled white block to a viewport; secondary actions are outlined.
**Don't** round corners; the system has no radius.
**Don't** apply this system to the Electron app UI in `src/`, which has its own zinc UI.
